methodologyNotes: Dataset covers 11 robot mops and vac/mop hybrids. All entries independently re-verified against official brand product pages (irobot.com, us.roborock.com, us.narwal.com, eufy.com, ecovacs.com, dreametech.com, us.switch-bot.com) plus secondary corroboration (Vacuum Wars, PR Newswire, Android Police/Authority, Best Buy, Amazon). Corrections this pass: Roborock Qrevo MaxV suction 10000->7000 Pa and price 1399.99->1199.99 (launch MSRP); iRobot Braava Jet m6 price 249.99->449.99 (iRobot list). suction_pa is the manufacturer peak figure in Pascals; water_tank_ml is the robot's onboard reservoir (not the base station); self_washing_mop is true only when the dock auto-washes the mop; auto_mop_lift is true when the robot autonomously lifts/retracts the mop pad over carpet. accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: iRobot Braava Jet m6
products.priceNote: iRobot.com list price; launched at $499 MSRP in 2019; Amazon street price frequently dips to ~$210-250
products.provenance: Announced May 2019 at $499 MSRP. iRobot.com lists the robot around $449.99 (heavily discounted from MSRP); the draft's $249.99 reflected only an understated Amazon street price, corrected to the published iRobot list price of $449.99 (note that Amazon street can dip lower). Water tank 540 ml confirmed via iRobot replacement-tank listing. Mop-only with Precision Jet Spray pad system and vSLAM navigation confirmed; no suction, no self-washing, no mop lift. Not discontinued.

products.name: iRobot Roomba Combo j9+
products.priceNote: MSRP per iRobot official product page
products.provenance: Price $1,399.99 re-confirmed live on the official iRobot product page. Shipped October 2023. Auto-Retract Mopping System (D.R.I.) lifts the mop pad to the top of the robot over carpets - re-confirmed on the iRobot page. Self-emptying 60-day bin and 30-day auto-fill water dock confirmed; the dock does NOT auto-wash mop pads. Suction Pa and exact onboard water tank ml not published by iRobot (null).

products.name: Narwal Freo X Ultra
products.priceNote: Current price on us.narwal.com (down from $899.99); launched at ~$1,399 MSRP in March 2024
products.provenance: Current price $699.99 re-confirmed live on the official Narwal US product page (shown as $200 off $899.99); announced CES Jan 2024, shipped March 2024 at ~$1,399 launch MSRP per Android Authority. 8200 Pa suction re-confirmed on product page and Android Authority review. Rotating mop pads confirmed; auto mop lift and self-washing at base station confirmed. Onboard robot water tank ml not published (null); base station holds 5 L clean / 4.5 L dirty.

products.name: Roborock S8 MaxV Ultra
products.priceNote: MSRP per Roborock US official store; frequently discounted
products.provenance: MSRP $1,799.99 re-confirmed on Roborock US page (current sale $799.99); unveiled CES 2024, open sale ~April 22 2024. 10,000 Pa HyperForce suction re-confirmed on official page and Best Buy. VibraRise 3.0 vibrating mopping confirmed; auto mop lift confirmed; hot-water washing + heated drying confirmed. 100 ml onboard water tank confirmed via Roborock support. PreciSense LiDAR confirmed.

products.name: Roborock Qrevo
products.priceNote: Original launch MSRP; now heavily discounted (refurb ~$299.99)
products.provenance: Original US MSRP $899.99 confirmed; 5500 Pa suction re-confirmed on the official page (current refurb listing $299.99). Dual spinning (rotating) mops confirmed. 80 ml onboard water tank per Roborock support/Vacuum Wars; dock holds 5 L clean water. Auto mop lift and self-washing + self-emptying (2.7 L bag) confirmed. Release year kept as 2023 (base Qrevo predates the CES-2024 MaxV/Pro variants).

products.name: Ecovacs Deebot T30S Combo
products.priceNote: MSRP per Ecovacs US for the T30S COMBO (DEEBOT + handheld vacuum) bundle
products.provenance: MSRP $1,199.99 for the T30S COMBO (DEEBOT + handheld) confirmed per PR Newswire and 9to5Toys; announced/launched May 2024 (releaseDate refined from 2024 to 2024-05). 11,000 Pa suction confirmed on official page and Amazon. OZMO Turbo 2.0 dual-plate rotating mop confirmed; auto-lift on carpet confirmed. 55 ml onboard water tank confirmed; self-emptying and hot-water mop washing confirmed.

products.name: Eufy X10 Pro Omni
products.priceNote: MSRP per eufy.com product page (launch promo was $799.99)
products.provenance: Price $899.99 re-confirmed live on the official eufy.com product page (the $799.99 was an early-launch promo). Released February 20, 2024 per Vacuum Wars. 8,000 Pa suction confirmed on official page, Amazon and Walmart. MopMaster 2.0 dual rotating mop pads confirmed; auto mop lift 12 mm confirmed. 80 ml onboard water tank confirmed on official page. iPath Laser (LiDAR) navigation confirmed.

products.name: Dreame L20 Ultra
products.priceNote: Current list/typical street price; launched at $1,499.99 MSRP in September 2023
products.provenance: Launched IFA September 2023 at $1,499.99 MSRP; current Amazon list ~$699.99 (street sales $380-540). 7,000 Pa Vormax suction confirmed via Amazon listing and reviews. DuoScrub rotating mop pads with MopExtend auto-removal at dock and ~10.5 mm mop lift confirmed. 80 ml onboard water tank; base station 4.5 L clean / 4 L dirty. LiDAR navigation confirmed.

products.name: SwitchBot S10
products.priceNote: MSRP per SwitchBot US; frequently discounted
products.provenance: MSRP $1,199.99 confirmed by SwitchBot US and Android Police review (~$1,200). Available 2024 (Kickstarter Oct 2023, retail 2024). 6,500 Pa suction confirmed on Amazon listing. RevoRoll roller mop (mopping_system corrected from generic 'rotating' to 'roller') with dual-station design and plumbing-optional Water Station confirmed. 250 ml onboard water tank per SwitchBot support. Self-emptying 90 days, auto mop washing/drying, LiDAR navigation confirmed.

products.name: Roborock Qrevo Curv 2 Flow
products.priceNote: MSRP per Roborock US; launch promo price $849.99
products.provenance: MSRP $999.99 re-confirmed on Roborock US page (current $849.99 promo); unveiled CES Jan 6 2026, available Jan 19 2026. 20,000 Pa HyperForce suction re-confirmed on official page. Roborock's first roller mop - SpiraFlow 270 mm roller confirmed (mopping_system corrected from 'rotating' to 'roller'). Auto roller lift and hot-water washing/drying confirmed. Onboard robot tank ml not published (null).

products.name: Roborock Qrevo MaxV
products.priceNote: Launch MSRP per CES 2024 announcement; official page currently lists $699.99 (compare-at $1,399.99)
products.provenance: Launch MSRP $1,199.99 per CES 2024 PR Newswire and availability coverage (price corrected from draft's $1,399.99, which is only the page's strikethrough/compare-at figure; current sale $699.99). Suction CORRECTED 10,000 -> 7,000 Pa per official page and Vacuum Wars - the Qrevo MaxV is 7,000 Pa HyperForce, not 10,000. Previewed CES 2024, on sale April 2024 (releaseDate refined to 2024-04). Dual spinning (rotating) mops with FlexiArm, auto mop wash + self-empty (Multifunctional Dock), 10 mm auto mop lift, PreciSense LiDAR confirmed. Onboard water tank ml not published (null).
